title: How to use the new ChatGPT app integrations, including DoorDash, Spotify, Uber, and others | TechCrunch
summary: OpenAI integrates apps like Spotify, Uber, Angi, Booking.com, Canva into ChatGPT, allowing users to ask for playlists, home improvement advice, hotel bookings, and graphic designs directly in the AI chatbot. However, these integrations share user data with ChatGPT, raising privacy concerns.
sentiment_reason: The sentiment is negative due to privacy concerns associated with sharing app data with ChatGPT.
